Mindy Support

org.mindy_support

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Current provider documentation received separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI content reviews for the exact imported observations. The official undated FAQ offers managed image, text, speech-recognition, video and3D point-cloud annotation. The scope is separate from its general BPO/customer-support services. Separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews are complete for the exact imported observations. Actual full/partial/unread source scopes are retained; no operational audit, commercial quality endorsement or automatic review of mentioned benchmarks is implied.
